players.product: network-on-chip (NoC) interconnect IP for AI SoCs

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 revenue by product line (Arteris operates in one reportable segment): total revenue $70,579 thousand for the year ended December 31, 2025 versus $57,724 thousand in 2024 (+22%); licensing, support and maintenance $63,859 thousand (+21%); variable royalties $6,596 thousand (+50%); other $124 thousand. The 10-K estimates Arteris solutions have been incorporated into over four billion production SoCs since inception.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $70,579 thousand (+22% from $57,724 thousand); licensing, support and maintenance $63,859 thousand (+21%); variable royalties $6,596 thousand (+50%); over four billion production SoCs since inception

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration (customer not named): in 2025 one customer represented more than 10% of revenue - Customer C at 13% of revenue in 2025 (15% in 2024). For 2025, 60.3% of revenue came from customers outside the United States and 24.5% from customers located in China (62.3% and 29.2% in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: Customer C 13% of 2025 revenue (15% in 2024); 60.3% of revenue outside the U.S.; China 24.5% of revenue (29.2% in 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K named customers and licence: the 10-K names Texas Instruments and Samsung Electronics as key customers whose agreements have historically provided for indemnification, and lists established automotive customer relationships with Mobileye, Renesas, Socionext, NXP, BMW and Bosch. Arteris licenses FlexNoC-related technology from Qualcomm under a License Agreement dated October 11, 2013 (no charge, perpetual unless terminated); Qualcomm may terminate rights to a FlexNoC development environment on a change of control of Arteris.
